title: Spectral Thickness of Fibonacci Hamiltonians
known_component: Published positive-constant upper and lower bounds of order 1/lambda as lambda tends to zero.
strongest_verified_result: Known weak-coupling order law, plus elementary non-spectral obstruction lemmas and a conditional finite-gap monotonicity lemma.
remaining_mathematical_gap: A coupling comparison uniform over every gap generation, or a certified spectral pair contradicting monotonicity. The conditional finite-gap lemma does not supply the required spectral endpoint hypotheses or the uniform limiting comparison.
